en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with four photographs from the Kriebethal/Kriebstein area. The upper left shows a country inn labelled "Gasthof Kriebethal" surrounded by trees. The upper right shows a railway line entering a truss bridge with a prominent hilltop castle in the background, captioned "Burg Kriebstein". The lower left image depicts a concrete dam with water spilling over, titled "Talsperre Kriebstein". The lower right view shows a wooded reservoir landscape with a boat on the water, captioned "Partie an d. Talsperre".
